title: Capstone: grade a real set this week
goal: Put it all together — make and check a feedback set for a stack you actually owe this week.

blocks.title: Bring it all together
blocks.body:
Last one — and this time it's a real stack you owe this week.

Make the feedback set, then check it like the expert you now are: fair, on-rubric, right level, warm tone. Make it, check it, use it.

blocks.scaffold: Write rubric-aligned feedback for my {{gradeBand}} {{subject}} {{artifact}} against these criteria: [paste your rubric]. Warm and specific, one strength and one next step each, no student names.
